findings.concern: Unrelated CSS edits in working tree
findings.detail: Palette/shadow tweaks across App.css, AuthPage.css, ChatArea.css, Sidebar.css, admin/AdminLayout.css, admin/AdminSidebar.css, admin/Manager.css, admin/ProviderManager.css, plus build-log/package-lock/dist_check artifacts, are present alongside the Users files. They carry no Users-feature logic and do not break the feature. If a clean per-feature commit is desired, stage only the Users files and commit the CSS polish separately.
